bio: A stone's throw from the Grand Hôtel, this spot is run by a young couple. The menu features creative tapas (duck heart skewers, orange balsamic reduction, black garlic) and classics (baby squid in persillade), as well as unadulterated contemporary bistro fare: braised leeks, a robust vegetable jus and rocket jam; beef cheek confit in a squid ink jus. The desserts are just as impressive, not least the cappuccino txokola, composed of a coffee cream, soft sponge, and yoghurt sorbet. Expect generous, straightforward and well-seasoned cooking. A cosy decor, a cordial team and reasonable prices.
